name: carnice-v2-27b-nvfp4-text-mtp-rtx5060ti-2gpu-agentic-160k-fp8kv-mtp3
notes: Production 2x RTX 5060 Ti 16GB probe for Carnice NVFP4/modelopt with vLLM tensor_parallel_size=2, fp8 KV cache, 153.5K context, gpu_memory_utilization=0.91, max_num_seqs=1 after 160K at 0.90 lacked KV cache and 0.95/c=2 OOMed at startup and near-160K prompt, max_num_batched_tokens=8192, prefix caching, and Qwen3.5 MTP speculative decoding n=3. Uses fp8 KV instead of TurboQuant because TurboQuant KV is unsupported for Qwen3 hybrid attention+Mamba models in current vLLM.
